148007.description:
Mi Xi Yao accidentally meets the young and vivacious Pharaoh while time traveling to 3100 BC, using the identity of his fiancee. Drawn into the tide of history in the mystical age of myths and legends, Mi Xi Yao witnesses Egypt's unification under Menes's rule. Though Menes loves Bernier, she is not the real Bernier. Will Menes discover Bernier's true identity? Is it their destiny? Will the changes they make in the past alter history forever?

(Source: INKR)

148008.description:
Father always took good care of me when I was a child even while living with relative’s and moving from house to house. It's not that I don't understand why my father took care of me, but... I guess It's okay not to dig too deep, right? Because that’s what family is for.

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

148009.description:
Luce, the devil more infamously known as Lucifer, plans a wager with God over the pure-souled Elijah. But when Elijah finds out who he really is and asks him not to give up, Luce becomes his guardian instead — waiting for the day they'll strike a deal that could damn a soul... or change a devil forever.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

148010.description:
The story of "Ah Chu and You Xin", of witnessing certain death and uncertain love. Where sorrow and hope overlap, their feelings begin to bud.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

148011.description:
BL retellings of classic fairy tales.

Volume 1
1. "Tebukuro wo Kaini" Tebukuro wo Katte (【手袋を買いに】手袋を買って、, "Buying Mittens" Buy Some Mittens and...) [Ichi Kotoko]
Once upon a time, a small fox was asked by his mother to buy a pair of gloves. He takes the form of a young boy and heads for town. Upon arriving, he goes to the shop of a nice young hat-maker. His mother warned him sternly before going out: "You mustn't let your true form be discovered!" But right away the fox jumps at a loud sound and out pop his real ears and his tail. Looking up at the young hat-maker, his whole body trembling in fear, the young fox asks "Are you going to eat me...?" You'll have to read to find out what the hat-maker does next...

2. "Shirayukihime" Shirayukihime no Sainan (【白雪姫】 白雪姫の災難, "Snow White" Snow White's Misfortune) [Owal]
Snow White is being hunted by his evil stepmother because of his overwhelming cuteness! He meets a group of horny dwarves in the woods after being chased from the castle. They mess with Snow White's body as he sleeps... However, he has no choice but to hide in their house to protect himself. Even while he's there though, the queen is able to reach him with her evil magic! "Save me, Prince...! He's super handsome... But wait! He's a pervert!" What will happen to Snow White?!

3. "Nagagutsu wo Haita Neko" Kimi ga Ichiban (【長靴をはいた猫】 きみがいちばん, "Puss in Boots" You're My Number One) [Sakura Riko]
"I'll show you a good time, Master" When the father of three boys passes away, all that's left to the youngest son is one cheeky male cat. Seeing the youngest son hanging his head in disappointment, the cat asks that boots and a bag to be prepared for him. Although the young man thinks the cat is strange, he does as he is asked. Soon he is being led around by the cheeky cat and in the end finds himself in the King's court being called a Duke. And on top of that, the young and innocent prince of the kingdom even proposes to him! From the cheeky yet earnest young cat, to the goofy and shining prince, and even a pheromone-driven handsome beast... our young hero's days are filled with trials galore.

4. "Rapunzel" Hatsukoi (【ラプンツェル】初恋, "Rapunzel" First Love) [Haruno Moe]
Rapunzel is a magical young man with long, beautiful hair, who contrary to his elegant looks is crazy about sex. One day, the kind Prince (who also just happens to be class president) is shown Rapunzel's true self by the Witch. Prince finds himself drawn in by the curious difference between the Rapunzel who loves sex, and the Rapunzel who always looks so lonely in class...

5. "Ousama no Mimi wa Roba no Mimi" Fureau Kimochi (【王様の囁はロバの耳】 ふれあうきもち, "The King Has Donkey Ears" Oh, How They Feel) [Magnesium]
The prince has a secret and it is because of that secret that he's been shut away in the basement of a castle all his life. His parents have all but abandoned him and it isn't until a young barber with a marvelous smile comes along that the young Prince is able to open his heart. And that is because, the barber is the first person to look at the prince's unusual ears and tell him they're charming. Told by the barber to keep his hair long, he does so just to feeling the barber play with his hair and touch his overly sensitive ears, because it's the only happiness he can find in life. The Prince just can't stop himself from falling in love.

6. Ari to Kirigirisu Ari to Kirigirisu no Komoriuta (【アリとキリギリス】アリとキリギリスの子守唄, "The Ant and the Grasshopper" The Ant and the Grasshopper's Lullaby) [Mei]
Kiri is a grasshopper who loves to live life to the full. One day, he is unable to find a place to stay for the night and so goes to find shelter in his usual fallback, the factory. Who should find him there but the hard-working ant, Kuronaga. Kuronaga is the exact opposite of the laid-back Kiri and yet somehow they hit it off well together. Despite this, the freedom-loving Kiri can't bring himself to go and stay with Kuronaga. This is the heart-warming story of their love.

7. "Ookami to Shichihiki no Koyagi" Yoiko no Orusuban (【オオカミと七匹のこやぎ】よい子のおるすばん。, "The Wolf and the 7 Billy Goats" Take Care of the House Like a Good Boy.) [Katagiri Atsuko]
The youngest billy goat kid is stuck watching the house alone today. That's when a big bad wolf who wants to eat him appears! He pretends to be the goat's mother and enters the house. Finally... that delicious white skin will be mine...!... is what he thinks, but seduced by the young goat's defenselessness they end up in bed together. What will he do when the goat kid asks for milk and starts suckling on his chest?!

8. "Akazukin-chan" Akazukin to Ookami-san (【赤ずきんちゃん】赤ずきんとオオカミさん, "Little Red Ridinghood" Little Red Riding Hood and the Big Bad Wolf) [Tomono Kasa]
Little Red Riding Hood loves his grandmother very much, and delivers food to her house every week. But lately a strange figure has been appearing in her house... it's a handsome human-loving wolf! The wolf has become attached to the family like a dog, but Red Riding Hood is suspicious and doesn't let down his guard. But one day, the wolf stops coming. Red Riding Hood feels his absence like a hole and his heart, and when he finds a wounded wolf in the woods, he...

(Source: Renta!)

148012.description:
The Southern Line Express carries all sorts of passengers. Sovian Darnell is just the newest to join the train's economy class after he's tasked with smuggling an invaluable bead across the tundra. But nothing could have prepared him for the dark reality he's met with after he accepts a seemingly innocuous drink from another rider. Suddenly, Sovian is overcome with an insatiable lust that must be quenched, and everyone on the express wants a piece of him. With no place to hide on an unstoppable train, he'll have to service his fellow libidinous travelers until he can make it to his destination. But will his stop ever come? Sovian is in for one hell of a ride, but once you hop on this train, there's no getting off.

(Source: Tappytoon)

148014.description:
Nozomi Shindo is housesitting for her uncle for two weeks while he's on an international business trip, and though she knows she ought to let the neighbors know, she thinks it's too much trouble...until her neighbor happens to be utterly gorgeous. His name is Yuta Honjo, and she's in love at first sight, until his roommate Chiaki Shiki steps out and is somehow even more gorgeous than Yuta. The possibility of a relationship between her gorgeous neighbors fuels her fujoshi mind (and her online novel), but she can't help but wonder...what is the actual relationship between the two? And is there any space in it for her? From the author of Boss Wife!

(Kodansha USA)

148015.description:
Jinwoo Kim, a university student with severe social anxiety, returns to school, determined to make new friends and overcome his conditions. But when his eyes meet Han Choi, the handsome and popular underclassman, he gags and runs out. Humiliated, Han vows to make Jinwoo fall for him. A seductive race between an introvert and prince charming... Who will be the winner?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: Chapter count includes 6 extra chapters.

148016.description:
Having been dumped by his girlfriend, Yang Yiyun found a precious treasure called the Universe Vessel in his moment of despair. He received the guidance of a Deity and took his first step on the path of cultivation. Medical skill, martial arts, divine techniques… He's skilled in all of them! A proud and cold president of a company, a rich businesswoman, a single mother, a gorgeous policewoman… All of them are at his side! This is the tale of a nobody who cultivates to godhood!

(Source: WebComics)

148017.description: Note: Chapter count includes one extra chapter.

148020.description:
They live under our feet... Si-Hwan Kim decides to stay at Da-Bin Park's house for a while. Little does he know that unidentified ants dwell below... Through an experiment, a monster-like ant creature is born and begins to kidnap people. Will Si-Hwan and Da-Bin, who are now caught up in the incident, be able to escape after twists and turns?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

148021.description:
A woman named Mitsuki Murase, afraid her husband will discover her unfaithfulness, is attacked on the road by a white van. The driver, none other than Rohan himself, tries to warn her that a prominent climate activist is hiding in her car, using her as transportation for a terrorist plot. The ensuing crash leaves Rohan nearly immobilized, forcing him to choose between the eco-terrorist's noble goal and the well-being of his hometown.

(Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

148022.description:
“Can’t I fall for you if I’m serious and not just playing around?”

In an effort to raise the daughter of his late sister, Rika, Satoshi abandons his past ways of being a playboy and, with the help of those around him, tries to become a good father.

However, with the relatives who had been helping him moving away, he gets help from a kindergarten teacher named Yukito. Yukito, who is calm and gentle with the face of an idol, is beloved by Rika and the other kindergarten children.

One day, when Satoshi is about to see off Yukito who came to his house to help out, he is suddenly pressed up against the wall and asked “Don’t you remember when I hit on you, Satoshi-san?”

A romantic comedy about a younger, handsome kindergarten teacher and former playboy dad raising a kid.

(Source: Cosmic Shuppan, translated)

148023.description: Moe is the youngest daughter of two tennis players who adopted her. When her father dies in an accident, she'll find the force to live thanks to her friend Sakuya and tennis.

148025.description:
Narumi Hakobe is a high school student who constantly has a blank expression on his face. Even in class, he's quiet and unassuming. His joy in life is keeping up with posts from "Efa," a girl who takes lewd photos and posts them on social media. But soon, he finds out that Efa's true identity is none other than...his diligent and popular classmate Mitsuha Koto...?!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.native: フィルター越しのカノジョ

148026.description:
Sanada Shirou thought escaping his dead-end corporate job would mean peace at last—until he wakes up in a world where women rule the battlefield and men are treated like fragile treasures. Gifted with creation magic, Shirou figures the smart move is to open a cozy inn and live the slow life he’s always wanted. But “slow” doesn’t last long when the fiercest fighters and boldest beauties of this matriarchal world start checking in…and checking him out! Between building the perfect inn and surviving as the entertainment for his rowdy residents, Shirou’s new life is shaping up to be anything but ordinary in this sexy isekai romp.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: Let’s Run an Inn on Dungeon Island! (In a World Ruled by Women)
title.native: ダンジョン島で宿屋をやろう！ 創造魔法を貰った俺の細腕繁盛記
title.romaji: Dungeon Tou de Yadoya wo Yarou! Souzou Mahou wo Moratta Ore no Hosoude Hanjouki

148027.description:
Shiro Sanada, who works for an exploitative company, got hooked into another world. There, he found a world where men and women's positions are reversed from our world! The women are in charge of dangerous adventures and battles, and men are in charge of housework. After escaping from the castle where he was captured, Shiro arrived on a deserted island. Using the "creation magic" granted to him by the Goddess, he decided to start an inn for visitors to the island's dungeon, but...

Everyone was looking at me, a fragile man, with dirty looks in their eyes...... trying to seduce me.
The story of a man who entertains the women of another world begins!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title.native: ダンジョン島で宿屋をやろう！ 創造魔法を貰った俺の細腕繁盛記

148028.description:
One day, a boy named Fuu Ondo suddenly became super attractive to older woman. He thought this would be an enviable situation, but it turns out that the ladies love him so much that he might just die...! This is a slapstick romantic comedy about crazed women who try to pamper their precious little boy, and the boy who feels as if his life is in danger, but maybe it's not so bad? This is a one-note shota love-comedy by Anu-sensei!

(Source: Comic Zenon, translated)

148030.description:
Shinichi, sporting a new look as a college debut virgin who's participating in a mixer, is for some reason getting sharp looks from Takemi, a tanned, busty gal...!

He witnesses Takemi getting accosted by thugs and gets into a fight against them to protect her, but gets beaten up instead. When he wakes up, he's in Takemi's room!? To his surprise, she also got an image change in her college debut and amazingly, she's "that Takemi", the same girl who went to Karate club with him way back in elementary and middle school!

On top of that, she invites him with the words "Why don't you stay over for today?"—!!

(Source: DMM, translated)

Note: Published in COMIC Anthurium 2022-02

148032.description:
Neither human nor demon. Landros is a lonely half-demon persecuted by both sides. He naively fell in love with Char, the only girl who has ever shown him kindness. And he was determined to put an end to the war that threatened her. Manipulating a wide variety of weapons with his rare spatial magic, he single-handedly defeated the evil demon lord! The strongest man began a slow life earnestly earning money to help his friends, even while being called a pervert and a weirdo (?)! He was happy to see Char again, but behind his back, his enemies were trying to use her as bait to lure him into a trap......

(Source: TO Books, translated)

Aki and Mikoto Tachihara are cousins and they attend the same middle school. Aki is a bad student and relies a lot on Mikoto, while harbouring a secret crush for him. One day, after a mysterious dream, she finds an unknown girl in her bedroom: her name is Nao, and seems to come... from 25 years ago?!

Note: Includes the one shots "Pearl no Kimochi" (パールの気持ち) and "Himawari no Illusion" (ひまわりのイリュージョン)

148043.description: What these young boys were entrusted with was, the future of gymnastics ------ in order to unearth talent for the Tokyo Olympics, middle schoolers are gathered together. These boys have harsh trials and a strict selection test to look forward to... which of them can survive?

148044.description:
A collection of stories:

1. Memeru (め～め～る～)
2. Debipippi (デビピッピ)
3. Te no Naka no Uchuu (手のなかの宇宙)
4. Hitomebore Zensen (ヒトメボレ前線)

148045.description:
What are Chinese folktales? They are ancient legends passed down by word of mouth, the distillation of a thousand years of folk wisdom. They collect the people's life experiences and imaginations, weaving their emotions into short stories. They represent hundreds and thousands of years of intelligence and inspiration from the Chinese people. Sima Gonggong brings six such stories to life, finding inspiration in the historical stories to express the difficulties of daily life such as greed, anger, obsession, and evil. Some will face difficulty and loss, others will gain fame and riches. Some will do good even in poverty, while others will betray good intentions. That is the legend of "Dao."

(Source: Baike, translated)

title.native: サイドオブパラダイス

148049.description:
She had a dream: the world was brimming with light. Family. School. Friends. Trains. Buses. Movies. Books. In that world of light, she grew into adulthood… and at the very end, in a white room, she fell into darkness. She awoke from the dream to find that she had become a demon. In the demon world, she lived a carefree life until she encountered a powerful being.

After such a long time spent living as a demon, before she knew it, spreading in her heart was a yearning for that world of light. She plunged herself into a summoning magic circle that had appeared. Then… when she opened her eyes once again, she had become a human baby.

She was in the Holy Kingdom. She felt fearful: while she was indeed a demon, she only had the strength of a baby. Her being a demon, if discovered, would be terrible. Was she a human or a demon? Would she be able to survive from here on out?

148050.description: The story is set in the 19th century and follows a man who dedicates his life to fighting a giant whale. In those days, people used whale oil instead of petroleum to light their lamps, and the oil extracted from sperm whales was traded at a high price.

148051.description:
Remi doesn't know what love feels like. In the summer two years after she gets her first full-time job, she bumps into Hodaka Arishima, a guy she was friends with benefits with back in school. Even though he was a playboy, he was also popular. For some reason, they had great chemistry. More than anything, he was a jerk who knew every inch of her body. After one particular incident, though, they stopped all contact with each other. Hodaka reassured her that she wasn't special to him, and since he smiled when he said it, Remi now thinks they can become friends again. That assumption changes when this older Hodaka declares that he won't wait for her any longer. He'll make her feel so good that she'll cry in pleasure? And this time, they'll finally share real love and real lovemaking.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Chapter count includes four extra chapters.

title.native: 亜空の聖女　～妹に濡れ衣を着せられた最強魔術師は、正体を隠してやり直す～
title.romaji: Akuu no Seijo: Imouto ni Nureginu wo Kiserareta Saikyou Majutsushi wa, Shoutai wo Kakushite Yarinaosu

148053.description:
Lucille was unceremoniously fired from the mansion where she had lived and worked as a maid for three years. She came to the countryside in search of a new job, and was introduced to the home of Phyllis, a taciturn and unfriendly wizard. The job at the house of Phyllis, a difficult man who hates "unnecessary things," turned out to be a great opportunity for Lucille! In order to hold on her new job at all costs, she began to carefully observe Phyllis in order to avoid any "superfluous" landmines. As she gradually got to know Phyllis better, she encounters an unexpected side of him that was not him just being difficult, and Lucille's feelings gradually changed.

(Source: MF Bunko, translated)

title.native: 永年雇用は可能でしょうか　～無愛想無口な魔法使いと始める再就職ライフ～
title.romaji: Einen Koyou wa Kanou Deshou ka: Buaisou Mukuchi na Mahou Tsukai to Hajimeru Sai Shuushoku Life

148054.description:
After school, Kotaro Nakayama returns to the classroom to pick up something, and he finds Shiho Shimotsuki asleep in the empty room. Shiho is rumored to be the favorite of Ryoma Ryuzaki, a boy popular with all the girls, even though she always seems expressionless and no one has ever seen her smile. But all of a sudden, she is holding Kotaro's hand!?

"You are the one that's special to me."

The popular web sensation has been adapted into a novel and finally into a manga!
The girl who falls in love with a boy and changes their destiny.

(Source: Micro Magazine, translated)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

"Who was the one who kept teasing me?" He gazes at me in earnest while he toys with me. I can't let him do this, but I'm so far gone...!

(Source: Coolmic)

148056.description:
The amateur author Bai Zixi transmigrated into her own novel, becoming the innocent heroine, due to be seduced and abused by the handsome CEO. But she didn't mind being teased, after all the CEO is amazing and handsome, just like how she wrote it! Every word she wrote has come true so far. But what she didn't realize was that even her typos and mistaken words will be taken literally and come true, too!!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

148057.description:
It's good to be honest. Probably. When Shuji's parents went on a business trip overseas, they arranged for a maid to move in. She's cute, but can't keep anything secret! With a clear, innocent gaze, she casually blurts out the most outrageous things... A normal teenage boy in his second year of high school is about to have his life thrown upside down living under the same roof as a girl who can't help but say whatever's on her mind!!

(Source: emaqi)

148058.description:
The leader of the student council, Gu So-Jeong, is loved by all the students. While cracking down on delinquents, he meets the man of his dreams in the bathroom.

So-Jong goes to the bathroom hoping to meet him again, but when he finally reunites with his ideal type, he accidentally touches his private area(?)...!

A love comedy with misunderstandings and confessions!

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

148059.description:
'Cherry' is forced to go on a trip to Paris following a travel app due to her sister's threats. In a completely new place, he encounters his very familiar rival, 'Lemon'.

'Cherry' tries to ignore 'Lemon', which makes him angry, and accidentally meets his partner 'Peach', and is drawn to 'Peach' who perfectly matches her ideal type...

The three become partners at the same time due to an error in the travel app of 'Lemon', 'Cherry', and 'Peach' as ​​if they interfered with the love of 'Cherry'!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

148060.description:
Various stories about dolls, ranging from horrifying to heartwarming, "Playing with Dolls," "Mannequin," "Marie with Blue Eyes," and "Ventriloquist's Love. "Ritual," in which four good friends made a deal with the devil to confirm their friendship. Misuzu Yamada, who is overshadowed at school, stops by a fortune teller's house because of her love life. There, Misuzu finds the means to change herself, and her final choice is... "Love's Wish Comes True".

(Source: Sukima, translated)

148061.description:
"I'm going to enjoy my second single life!"

Kazuha Ono is divorced at the age of 35 due to her husband's adultery. Refusing to feel down, she proudly tells her coworkers at a fashion magazine that she is now a free woman. A new coworker happened to be there to hear it, which made her feel a bit awkward. But then the that handsome new guy seems to take an interest in her after her announcement...?

148079.description:
After leaving her isolating life in Tokyo, 34-year-old Nichiko returns to her remote island hometown for her estranged alcoholic father's final days. There she meets Chimaki, an eccentric young man who stirs up old memories and feelings Nichiko had all but decided she no longer deserved. But despite his puppy-like enthusiasm for life, Chimaki's almost obsessive need to rescue people and animals seems to be compensating for an unspeakable past.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

148081.description:
Hayata Hayata, a middle-distance runner whose last high school race ended in disappointment, was planning to find a job in his hometown of Iwate after graduation...

However, he finds out that a private university, acquired by a major IT company, has established an ekiden team to compete in the "Hakone" relay race and is planning to hold a nationwide audition to recruit scholarship students. What's more, the team manager is a popular idol!

148082.description:
Maki Maehara is always on his own at school. He has no friends or hobbies others share, and he doesn't expect the upcoming academic year to be any different, even surrounded by new faces. And six months later, it seems like he was right-until he runs into his popular classmate Umi Asanagi at a video store! Always at the center of attention and called the "second prettiest in class" by the boys, Asanagi's from a totally different world. But it turns out the two have more overlapping interests than just the B-grade movies they came to check out...and Asanagi asks Maehara to be her friend!

(Source: Yen Press)

When Urich's daring attempt to venture near the ominous Sky Mountains with his friends gets him kidnapped, he learns that there is a new world that exists beyond his own. After a hellish fight with his attackers, he frees himself and sets off on a journey to explore this new realm. There, he encounters allies and enemies alike, each meeting helping him learn more about the civilization and grow as a warrior. But even Urich has yet to find out where his quest will truly take him...

In 15th century Italy, the monarchs of various kingdoms promoted the arts, and the movement to revive the classics, known as the "Renaissance," was underway. Leonardo da Vinci was an all-around genius active during that era. This manga adaptation of his posthumous manuscripts is filled with his masterful insights into nature, which he spent his entire life trying to elucidate.

(Source: Variety Art Works, translated)

148097.description:
As the spoiled son of a rich businessman, Yi Seo hates the idea of labor. So when his father threatens to cut him off unless he starts working, his first instinct is to run away to Germany. There, a mix-up involving suitcases results in him meeting the handsome Jaeha, who invites him to a bar for some wine. After a surprisingly deep conversation, the two men spend a passionate night together. But eventually, Yi Seo is kidnapped by his father's secretary and taken back to Korea. He then spends his days slacking off at his father's company... until Jaeha joins his department as the new team leader!

To Yi Seo's surprise, the man has zero tolerance for his laziness, and threatens to heat things up at work, where people could walk in on them at any minute! Will Jaeha succeed in whipping Yi Seo into a model employee with his torturous yet pleasurable punishments?

Manager Yoon Heedae just so happens to run into a guy who seems to fit the bill described in the post… Could Kim Siwon from operations be the serial homewrecker? After a slightly heated run-in, Heedae and Siwon’s relationship seems to have gotten off on the wrong foot. But as the need for the operations and sales teams to collaborate has grown, their paths are inevitably going to cross more. Plus, in a fit of panic, Heedae blurted out about his tremendous “experience” in relationships when the truth is anything but! Well, after a company outing for dinner and drinks, the time to put up or shut up has come. Will mutual curiosity get these office mates in bed or should they keep things strictly business?

The story opens in a burning Berlin in 1945. The "Golden Beast", who had performed the miracle of resurrection there, was interested in a secret operation, which was being carried out in secret. The name of the operation is "Werewolf".

148142.description:
Lydia thought she'd finally get to live a life of luxury after being reborn as a noble in a magical world. Little did she know, she's actually a side character in a novel doomed to die at the hands of Ash, the merciless, psychopathic villain. Her best shot at escaping is to have the heroine distract him while she tries to run away. But the only problem is... the heroine keeps dying! With a limited number of magic tricks up her sleeve and her quick wit, will Lydia ever make her great escape?

(Source: Tapas)

Veteran dancer Hiroya Kuroda is cast in "New Swan Lake" with Ryohei Shiraishi, a rising star in the ballet world. Shiraishi views Kuroda as a rival, but due to past trauma, Kuroda has no desire to compete with Shiraishi. Shiraishi's obsession with Kuroda began when admiring Kuroda's performance when he was a child, and it drove him to rise to that same level. Those feelings soon turn into a lustful love affair. Every time they dance together, their aroused desire can be felt through their tights.... Their time spent together moves Kuroda, who had been in pain, to a fever pitch...! Young talent and handsome veteran - the start of a deeply erotic competition!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

148152.description: Matarou Urami is a typical "bullied kid" with no apparent personality or appearance. He is bullied by various people each time, but when the bullying or misdeeds go too far that he cannot forgive, he goes around at night taking revenge with his supernatural power "Urami Nenpo", occult items, and cruel means. The concept of this suspenseful and bizarre drama depicts the insidious side of the human mind. Various items such as "bags" and "ropes" are used in each episode to bully Matarou, and he takes revenge using the same items.

148153.description:
Jackson, a boy from Ghana goes to Korea as an exchange student. A friend invites him to live in his house where he meets sexy women who spice up his life. Despite his lanky appearance, something huge lies in his pants...

148154.description:
Jeon Du-In’s relationship with Baek Ryong is complicated. He gets paid by Ryong to do dirty jobs, which is standard fare for a thug like him. The fact that they have sex together doesn’t make things that messy, either. The part where everything gets complicated is the fact that Du-In doesn’t really want any kind of relationship with Ryong in the first place. Du-In isn’t the type of man to be domesticated, and Ryong likes him that way…But he doesn’t want to let his “beast” go, either. A savagely captivating prequel to “Dispar”.

(Source: Lezhin US)

148155.description:
When his mother became the mistress of a wealthy chairman, Seon-Woo was forced into the role of a “perfect” son in a picture-perfect but hollow family. No matter how hard he tried, he could never measure up... Especially next to Seung-Wook, who seemed to have everything from the start. Their bond fractured, and they went their separate ways. Five years later, Seung-Wook returns from abroad, and their paths cross again. But instead of reconciliation, he offers Seon-Woo a dangerous proposition…one that crosses a line neither of them can ever take back.

(Source: Lezhin US)

In the 1970s, a secret operation was operated due to excessive loyalty to His Excellency and this became the basis for the establishment of Korea’s first hit-and-run company in the 1980s, when the government changed. The ace agent of the craft squad survives desperately and becomes the CEO of a killer company and leads the company...

(Source: Naver, translated)

148278.description:
When the author of Hero Lee’s favorite comic, Adventure King, starts killing off major characters and wraps it up with a huge letdown of an ending, he sells every book in disappointment. Right then, Hero receives a strange text from the author himself that all characters must endeavor to survive, and those who don't do not deserve a place in the story. After being asked if he would like to try it for himself, Hero wakes up inside the comic as Background Villain #3. Will he be able to survive the story and see it to the end?

(Source: WEBTOON)

148281.description:
My new stepbrother is an obnoxious womanizer, and even worse, he's my big sister's ex-boyfriend! Internet-famous med-student older brother x thrifty homebody high-school younger brother are dramatically reunited, as they try to get used to living together as a new family!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

148282.description:
Miyako and Tomiko are twins who run a real estate agency in Kichijoji, famous as the No. 1 place to live in Tokyo. Female clients flock to Kichijoji looking for its friendly and punky lifestyle, but the twins will show them other neighborhoods that are just as great! A manga about being on the move in the city!

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

148283.description: Two childhood friends, Noboru and Anne, grow up in France and love cycling. Noboru has never beaten Anne in a race. One day Noboru has to return Japan. Noboru and Anne make a promise to meet in the Tour de France as professional cyclists for their respective countries. A story of Noboru's struggle to fulfill that promise.

148286.description:
The genius neuroscientist Bai Yuekui tried to save hermentor by transplanting his brain into the body of a death-row inmate. At the same time, geological disasters started occurring all over the place. Jones stole the Angel Serum and caused a series of mutations, as Jiuchuan City became hell on earth. The dust has not yet even settled yet, when the final apocalypse came...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

148287.description:
If the twelve Chinese Zodiacs were being chosen today, who would be first, and who would be at the bottom? If other animals like cats, wolves, lions, and elephants joined in, which twelve animals would win out? This is a game, about choosing a new order for the twelve Chinese Zodiac! Gods, animals, and humans will work together to try to defeat their opponents and earn a place in the zodiac!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

148290.description:
Vincent, the agent of destiny, and Rue, the guardian, deliver presents to children around the world. These presents, known as 'the box of destiny' affect people's lives differently depending on the person's choice. The rule is that the agents must not interfere with the fate that the box brings, however, the warm-hearted Vincent often finds himself breaking the rules. One day, Detective Argio, who's been investigating a 30-year-old kidnapping case, meets Vincent, who looks strangely similar to a culprit he used to know. As Argio tries to uncover the mysteries behind Vincent, a new case of a missing child occurs and the evidences keep pointing towards Vincent as the prime suspect...

(Source: Copin Comics)

148294.description:
The only male of the Siyou clan has finally found another partner to call his own. They settle together in their own home, learning to manage the household and care for their child. A love story filled with intimacy that also focuses on the responsibility that comes with romance.

(Source: INKR)

148296.description:
Kousuke may be an omega, but he's a tough, blue-collar worker. He lives with his mate Haruka, a gentle alpha who works as a writer and stays home to care for their family, Kousuke and their two children, Marin and Yosuke. Being an omega, juggling work, housework, and parenting... life isn't always easy or fair. Even so, their days are filled with joy and warmth because Haruka, his one and only mate, showers him with endless love every single day.

(Source: Kadokawa)

Never did he, a 10,000 years old fox spirit, imagine that he would see the future scene after a catastrophe. High-rise buildings, brilliant lights, running cars. The ancient fox spirit was reborn to be an unpopular actor, let's see how he will surprise everyone, reap his true love and rock the entertainment circle!

With a hobby of writing BL novels, Akiharu, a university student fudanshi who loves shipping, quickly approaches his favorite ship (a delusion)? His dream of becoming a wall that watches over them was fulfilled —— was what he thought, but one day a shocking truth from the mouth of the uke (a delusion)….! But reality is stranger than his delusions! This is a new era of a fudanshi's heartful comedy!!

A new Railgun story by Kamachi Kazuma is about to begin!

Mikoto, Kuroko, Uiharu, and Saten ...... are all involved in this story!! From the moment she was betrayed by her first boyfriend, Makimura Sachie decides to live her life freely in a share-house that forbids love! But it seems like the people staying there all have different views on love...?

(Source: LINE, translated)

A girl who had reincarnated as Remilia, the villainess of an otome game tries to clear her name. However, the real Remilia who had been watching all along inside awakens.

Now it's time for the true villainess' revenge to begin!

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

148306.description:
After falling in love with his ex-professor living next door, Eun-Seong can no longer be satisfied with ordinary women. He knows it is wrong to do it with a married woman, but one thing leads to another...

"Do you... see me as a woman?"

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

148307.description:
I'm a zillionaire in a gacha game!
Obsessed with the clicker game Infinite Diamonds for over a year, Jae-Hee finally reaches the ultimate in-game achievement — only to suddenly find herself in the RPG gacha game Terrarium Adventure! Why was she pulled into the game, and how can she get out? For now, she has no choice but to explore!

(Source: Manta, edited)
synonyms: テラリウムアドベンチャー

148308.description:
When Emperor Rustanard of the Rusclan Empire summons the Otherworldly Savior from another world to fulfill a prophecy, he doesn’t expect to find 16-year-old Sihan Seong. The emperor casts him out, only to have Sihan return with a party of six warriors to defeat the so-called “Mad Emperor” and set the Rusclan people free. Just when victory is within Sihan’s grasp, he is betrayed by his teammates and sent back to his own world. 10 years later, Sihan returns to the Terranor Continent and finds an unlikely ally in Alita, the daughter of Rustanard…

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: Transmigrating to the Otherworld Once More

148310.description:
When Robelia Naegrad married Emperor Carmond DeHardt, it was expected that she would produce an heir to the imperial bloodline of the Golden Dragon, one who would inherit the family's mind-control abilities. However, with her own deadly powers being manipulated for her devious mother's mysterious scheme, Robelia must do all she can to avoid sharing a bed with her husband. Caught in between the two, will she be able to resist Carmond's continued seduction and avoid becoming her mother's pawn?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: How to Survive Sleeping With the Emperor

148311.description:
Minami and Yuzu have been inseparable since elementary school. But now that they’re in high school, Minami just can’t accept that Yuzu may someday get a boyfriend. How come some random guy gets to wake her up in the morning, feed her lunch, take baths with her…? It doesn’t take long for Minami to realize that her feelings can’t quite be described as “friendship” anymore, but how can she get Yuzu to see her the same way?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: How Do I Get Together With My Childhood Friend?
어떻게 해야 소꿉친구의 여친이 될 수 있나요?!

148312.description: After the questionable death of a patient, a young doctor is led to a mysterious club called Kamiya. Drawn by the allure of an employee and the rumors about vampires in the establishment, she decides to experience the club for herself.

148313.description:
In her previous life, Lin Yaoyue was framed by her lover and relatives. After dying in vain, she woke up to find that she was reborn in her youth. Lin Yaoyue vowed to make the villains pay for what they’ve done, but what she didn't expect was that Murong Jin, her enemy in her previous life, had become her lover in this life...

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Ji Du Jin Yue Zui Gong Liu

148314.description:
Fang, Beagle, and Kroos, trainee police officers of Columbia's Operations Preparation Detachment, are posted to intern in a pocket of the trade port Tkaronto. They have no idea a Catastrophe is already slipping silently toward Tkaronto...

(Source: Official Site)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

148315.description:
Jump into Dream Land with Kirby and gobble up some fun! Everyone’s favorite pink puff teams up with his friends to keep arch-frenemy King Dedede in line. Fans of all ages can enjoy this collection of classic Kirby comics—just take a deep breath and hop on in!

(Source: VIZ Media)

Note: These volumes are a best-of collection of the original 1994 serialization.

title.romaji: Hoshi no Kirby: Dedede de Pupupu na Monogatari Dedede-hen

148319.description:
Analyst...a "team mastermind" who analyzes the opposing team and instructs the coach on strategy from off the bench. Soichi Azuki is an analyst for the Nimura Kasei Gunmen's, a professional volleyball team. He is promised the position of All-Japan men's volleyball coach on one condition. That was to make the boys' volleyball club of a private junior high school, which had always been eliminated in the first round of regional qualifying, win the national championship!

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)

148320.description:
In the old town, there is a century-old restaurant called Shi Er. It looks ordinary on the outside, but it contains a vast fantasy world inside, where a mysterious creature resides. The restaurant's handsome owners serves up delicious bait to lure customers in, before turning them into food to feed the mystery creature. Until one day, when a stoic young girl came to the restaurant...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Saionji Makoto, heir to the company president, has a secret crush. It's Azuma Kouhei, an outstanding second-year employee who also works as the president's secretary.
Makoto fell for him at first sight… and now, Kouhei’s been assigned as his mentor! Over the moon, Makoto rushes to tell his twin sister, Mami.
But that’s where everything begins...
Because of her strange little spell, Makoto ends up turning into a stuffed toy right in front of Kouhei!?

(Source: Taiyoh Tosho, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.english: Is Life a Bed of Roses?

148324.description:
In a modern Japan where vampires and werewolves are commonplace in society, Kioi Uzuki runs a sharehouse with his grandmother. He's super excited when they get their first vampire tenant, but their first meeting is a bit of a bumpy one. How will this shy and closed off vampire react to a bubbly enthusiastic all-things-occult-loving human who really wants to be his friend?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

Four years ago, Ryo's father remarried, and Ryo suddenly became the eldest of four brothers. He's currently in the midst of a romance with the third son, Hayato, and although they're very happy together, there's one problem: Ryo's not good at sex...

(Source: Taiyo Tosho, translated and edited)

148328.description:
The story begins in 1927 (Showa 2) when four girls between the ages of 11 and 16 were sold to the Bakunishi brothel in Muroran, Hokkaido. Against the backdrop of the social conditions of the time, the girls' tumultuous lives are depicted.

(Source: Natalie.mu, translated)

148329.description:
Nao Watanuki has made a living swindling horny men out of their money. She thought she had a found a new sucker in Daisuke Yamazaki. As Nao tried all her usual tricks to entice him, Yamazaki's kindness towards her actually touched her heart...

(Source: Melon Books, translated)

Sabae Karin has always been pretty and popular, but for some reason, she's never been able to get together with anyone she likes. Now at the age of 37, she's ready to put it all on the line! Due to a misunderstanding, Yuzu Mikawa (31), the man she fell in love at first sight, thinks she's 25 years old. And now she is going on to the stage of love pretending to be a girl a whole zodiac cycle younger than her real age...

(Source: Jour Comics)

When Lin Yi was fired from his job, he triggered the Career Experience System by accident. The System offered Lin Yi various career opportunities and generous rewards for completing its missions. He took advantage of those rewards to achieve his ambitions of skills, riches, and power.

Tatsumi is a college student and a part-time manager for at a private beach that no one visits. His only customer is Ryo, a beautiful and tanned high school student who doesn't fit in with the other members in his beach volleyball club. Tatsumi identifies with the boy's situation and helps him practice. They grow closer over time, and finally Ryo begs Tatsumi to let him be on top if he wins his volleyball tournament...!

(Source: Renta!)

My wife lost her sight due to an accident. Was surviving actually better or worse for her? Living with the sister-in-law is harder than I thought.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

148337.description:
Long ago, ten suns rose into the sky, turning the earth into a scorched world crawling with demons. On the heavenly emperor’s orders, the hero Yae shot down nine of these ten suns. Many years later, the Solar Goddess initiates a conflict by releasing the demons with Hanbal in order to revive her sons. In response, the Heavenly Emperor calls upon Hang-ah and Dongbangsak in order to fight his wife... Can Hang-ah and Dongbangsak save the human world from the demons?!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

148338.description:
JI-Hyun is a district attorney who got swept into a corruption scandal and demoted to a rural district. Adding insult to the injury, she is held against her will by the locals molesters. She tries to get away, but her body says it otherwise.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

148339.description: Four years after the end of the One Year War between the Principality of Zeon and the Earth Federation, Cain Ragnard, a war orphan whose parents were killed by Zeon's attack on Side 7, has joined the Earth Federation Forces. For the vengeance of his parents, Cain joins the special force Shadows to hunt down the remnants of the Zeon menace. One day his team is sent to Earth to eliminate Zeon remnants in the Middle East, however, an act of betrayal changes everything...

Jin-Tae was supposed to have a great time at college but because of a cruel girl named Da-Gyeong, his reputation is in the dumps. But one day, he discovers her weakness.

"Now how shall I get my revenge on her?"

148342.description:
Branded as a cursed child, Princess Osiria spent most of her life locked in an attic. In actuality, Osiria is the divinely chosen, the one who could’ve saved the empire of Trionfo. Instead, she was sold to a neighboring kingdom and left in the care of Sir Fedelius, a handsome young knight. Although her heart beats faster when Fedelius is around, she doesn’t plan on staying for long. She wants only one thing… to get revenge on those who abused her and killed her mother. Will her heart soften with love or will she seek vengeance to the very end?

(Source: Tapas)

148343.description:
In a world plagued by viral bugs…

Monsters called “Bugs” plague the world. Cha-Eun, a member of the bug-exterminating organization "C.O.,” finds his chief, Ga-Yoon, both infuriating and admirable. Meanwhile, Cha-Eun catches the attention of Moon-Hoo, a member of the rival organization. What will become of this love triangle in this dangerous world?

(Source: Manta)

148344.description:
A collection of stories by various artists:

1. Tenshi-sama ni Furete wa Ikenai (天使様に触れてはいけない) [Yuka Nakajima]
2. Ouji-sama de Isasete (王子様でいさせて) [Chihiro Komori]

148345.description:
With their magic wands and names...
They were called monsters and witches before they were accepted into society. Now, they're known as magicians, and they exist to protect and assist humans. There are 24 of them in this world, each with their own rank and abilities. The curtains are drawn, and the stage is ready for them.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

148346.description:
Min-Young - having graduated from an all-girls middle school, high school, and college and now working as a lingerie designer - knows zero-to-nothing about men and subsequently has never dated anyone. When the CEO of her company suggests setting her up on a blind date, she has no other choice but to say yes. She goes on the date only to be faced with an off-putting yet handsome guy, who ignores her for the majority of the time but then has the audacity to suggest seeing each other. Flabbergasted, she decides to leave and to never see him again... little did she know, she would meet him the next day as the photographer on her project at work. On the other hand, Dong-Hwa remembers meeting Min-Young ten years ago and can't help but smile at her spunk and confidence. Despite her rather lukewarm reaction, he's determined to play to win her heart. Let the games begin!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

148347.description:
Dreams come and go, but this nightmare is here to stay. A-Reum keeps a note to keep track of her dreams and premonitions, which, to her horror, oftentimes become true. One day, she discovers a set of pages she doesn’t remember writing, and that’s when all hell breaks out in her school. Can she piece the broken parts of her dream together and survive the terror that lurks in the dark?

(Source: WEBTOON)

148348.description: “I think I’ve fallen for you…” A 4-page shorts collection of BL stories depicting such moments. Includes works of 29 popular and talented authors.

Taekil Goo. For him, his daily life was a series of boredom. Studying and staying at home were boring in everyday life, what he chose was an unconscious and meaningless runaway life. He headed to Wonju, and at the young age of 18, the world was full of curios things, and the people he met there were various. That is how a young boy, is adjusting to society. How will he live in a difficult world?

(Source: Kakao Webtoon, translated)

Note: Includes 6 extra chapters.

148350.description:
Amongst nobles and royals, Lady Agnes, daughter of an aristocrat is the "Rose Amongst Thorns," due to her unparalleled beauty. On the other hand, Bernard is the fifth son of a Lord who rules a small rural town far from the capital. At first glance, Bernard gets stared down in disgust by Lady Agnes, most likely because of his lowly status. Five years later, Lady Agnes's father faces trial due to embezzlement, resulting in her family losing everything. After receiving the status of a "fallen aristocrat," everyone leaves Agnes to fend for herself... except for Bernard, the low-ranking knight. A misunderstanding develops into a charming love story!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

沒落千金，成為貧窮騎士的女僕！

title.english: The Daughter of a Fallen Aristocrat Becomes The Poor Knight's Maidservant
title.native: 没落令嬢、貧乏騎士のメイドになります
title.romaji: Botsuraku Reijou, Bimbou Kishi no Maid ni Narimasu

148353.description:
After he loses his job and gets dumped by a former flame, Daniel longs to break away from the constant noise of the city. Little does he know that a sudden inheritance in the form of a countryside hotel could be just the quiet escape he needed. But as he works to breathe life into the old hotel, he quickly realizes that it's anything but ordinary. With ghosts supposedly lurking the halls, a mysterious wing that no one is allowed into, and secret dealings behind closed doors, Daniel has his work cut out for him. Still, he's determined to uncover the mysteries of Hotel Pharus, and with the help of a handsome and willing guest upstairs, he may get more than he bargained for. Will he find the answers he's looking for or come to realize that some secrets should stay buried?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

Note: Includes five epilogue chapters.
synonyms: ホテルパロス～その裏の顔は～

148355.description: Note: Published in Toaru Magazine: Toaru Kagaku no Accelerator x Toaru Kagaku no Railgun

title.native: とある佐天の風紀違反

148356.description:
The age of her marriage partner is 48 years old.
Song Yeon-Ju is forced to get married because of money.
Her opinion was completely ignored by the family, who asked her to repay their kindness for having her raised.

“I don’t want a young and pretty mother like you.”

Kang I-Won, 2 years younger than her, is her soon-to-be stepson.
He is the only one who discusses the flow of marriage.

148358.description:
Erena, a high school girl, died in a fire... but she was reborn in a parallel world! She now works as a housekeeper for a wealthy elderly couple, using the housekeeping skills she honed in her men-only family. One day, the elderly couple move in with their son, but his house is the royal castle! The couple were actually the retired previous King and Queen, and their son is the King! Can Erena's housekeeping skills help pave a new way for the kingdom?!

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Includes 16 extras chapters.
synonyms: Femme de ménage dans un monde parallèle
轉生侍女的王宮奮鬥記

title.english: I Was Reborn as a Housekeeper in a Parallel World!
title.native: 転生した異世界で家政婦になりました！
title.romaji: Tensei Shita Isekai de Kaseifu ni Narimashita!

148359.description:
I was open with you when I didn't care about you. But when I fell in love with you I became guarded with my emotions.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 2 extras.

148360.description:
Zhang Xiao just started playing a game called "King Of The Underworld" when he suddenly died and transmigrated into the game. See how he defeats all the plots and conspiracies to become the most powerful man in the Underworld, and conquer all the women along the way!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: I Opened a Harem in Hell
I Opened the Harem in the Underworld

148362.description: Note: The first twelve chapters were compiled in Takano's artbook "Tokyo Space Diary," published on April 7, 2006.
synonyms: Somewhere, Where We are Blown Off

title.native: 飛ばされていく　行く先

synonyms: The Serious Class Committee Chairman is Secretly a Dark-skinned Gyaru

title.native: クラスメイトのマジメ委員長は隠れ黒ギャル
title.romaji: Classmate no Majime Iinchou wa Kakure Kuro Gal

148367.description:
Heavy snow, strong winds, extreme cold, and an Antarctic winter with half of the year being night.
An unidentified 'something' appeared in front of researchers isolated in the worst conditions on Earth.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

148368.description:
Once upon a time, Lalisa Blick was abused by her family, who wanted to take her diamond tears for themselves. Then one day, a prince appeared to save Lalisa and ride off into the sunset with her. But why was I reborn into this fairy tale as the evil sister, Marcia?! I need to leave this wretched house... but how can I leave my poor sister here in this hell hole? Instead of waiting for the prince to come, I can just bring Lalisa to him. This way, both of us can live happily ever after, right?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.
synonyms: A Perfect Ending Plan of the Villain in a Fairy Tale
The Perfect Ending for the Villainess of a Fairy Tale
反派也想要有完美結局
แผนตอนจบสุดสมบูรณ์ของตัวร้ายในเทพนิยาย

title.english: The Perfect Plan for a Fairy-Tale Ending
title.native: 동화 속 악역의 완벽한 엔딩 플랜
title.romaji: Donghwa Sok Agyeogui Wanbyeokan Ending Plan

148369.description:
To save her younger sister Aria from her illness, Cassmire Crisis became a mercenary, wielding a sword and shedding blood to pay for her medicine. But when Cassmire suffers a fall one day, memories of her past life as Aria’s wicked stepsister come flooding back. Rather than take up the role of villainess again, Cassmire vows to protect Aria this time. But with Aria doomed by the story to face only hardships, Cassmire must pick up her weapon once more to become her sister’s loyal sword!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: I Was Planning to Become a Loyal Sword
I Tried To Be Her Loyal Sword
Je me suis retrouvée au centre d'un harem inversé

148372.description:
Jinha is an artist who specializes in glass art, but he has been struggling for years. He accepted his friend's mother as his student to teach his art, but her sexiness makes it difficult. While he is being distracted by his student's provocative actions, a plan is set in motion

(Source: INKR)
synonyms: In love with the friend’s mother

148373.description:
Following a long war, the Inorganics got hold of space as a whole. Even the great warriors of Zax from the Aqualoid planet couldn't defeat them. Rasa and Nam are the last generation of its dying people. In order to bring back freedom and its past glory, they go on a quest to find the sacred sword Shed. But in order to reach it, one must infiltrate the forbidden area : the Inorganics' temple.

(Source: Black Box, translated)

148380.description:
The second generation of gangland time-travelled as the pirate king's son in Galaxy. And the pirate king was just killed. We I thought that in the world I should have some special ability or power, mak money and live a rich life again. But since the eggs I saved accidentally hatched, it seemed that I not only have a dragon but also a husband? No no no, I like girls obviously.

(Source: WebComics)

148381.description:
She was once a favored princess, but she was betrayed on the eve of her wedding and killed herself by self-immolation. While her betrayers live a happy life, she was reborn as the bullied and unloved youngest daughter of an aristocratic family. But now she will rise up like the phoenix and find revenge, taming magical beasts, cultivating her powers, and mastering potions and poisons, to control life and death itself! She swears that she will pay back those who betrayed and humiliated her a hundred-fold!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: All The Princes Want To Marry Me
The Emperor Insisted on Having a Bride

title.english: Phoenix Soars Back To The Sky
title.native: 重生后皇子们闹着要娶我
title.romaji: Chongsheng Hou Huangzimen Naozhe Yao Qu Wo

148382.description:
Rosa dreams of taking up arms and protecting the people as a courageous knight! But in order to achieve this, she must first become a squire, and those duties around the castle are much less glorious. One moment she’s caring for horses in the stable, the next she’s chopping a huge pile of firewood or battling a mountain of laundry–and, of course, she must also be ever-ready to assist the knight she serves! Though her tasks in this role may seem mundane, all are important steps on her journey to becoming a knight worthy of legend. Rosa will face every challenge with the heart of a hero!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes six side-story and two omake chapters.
synonyms: Chivalric Romance Blooms Within The Castle Walls

title.english: The Knight Blooms Behind Castle Walls
title.native: 騎士譚は城壁の中に花ひらく
title.romaji: Kishitan wa Jouheki no Naka ni Hanahiraku

148384.description:
Education and suffering.

(Source: Fakku)

Note: Note: Published in Girls forM Vol.16.

148386.description:
"It's love at first sight. Please go out with me." Hana feels uncertain in her relationship with her smart, good-looking, and stylish boyfriend, Yuushi.

But just as she's thinking of breaking up with him, Yuushi is in an accident and ends up with amnesia! When Hana arrives at the hospital, Yuushi, who has lost all his memories of her, declares that he has fallen in love with her at first sight!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

title.english: Love Beyond Memories: Destined to Be Together?
title.native: 花と有志 運命の恋って、ありますか？
title.romaji: Hana to Yuushi Unmei no Koi tte, Arimasu ka?

148387.description:
Rando Shin, who lives in a Japan devastated by giant monsters, one day gained the ability to leap through time and transform into a humanoid monster. He decided to use that power to save his childhood friend, Azusa Nagi, who died in his past.

(Source: Sneaker Bunko, translated)

148389.description:
"If I sleep with an incubus, will my psychosexual disorder be cured?" From this union of fated interests, the world's purest romance will now begin...!?

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: The Incubus Boss and the Frigid Office Lady
title.native: ちゃんと、きもち、いい関係。～インキュバス上司×不感症OL
title.romaji: Chanto, Kimochi, Ikankei.: Incubus Joushi x Fukanshou OL

148390.description:
"I like to be slapped sharply, by a woman's... soft, supple palm..."

I unexpectedly picked up a high school girl who had fainted in front of my apartment building. Even though she had bruises on her face, I still had to ask myself, "I wonder if she is even real, such a beautiful girl..." That night after I took in the mysterious beauty for medical treatment, she turned up in my bed...?

(Source: Comico, translated)

title.romaji: Kimi no Tame Dake no Kubiwa

148392.description:
Da-Young Kim happily donated her liver to her mother-in-law, but all she got was betrayal in return. Her husband’s whole family nefariously used and abused her, kicking her out before she even fully recovered from surgery. They went on with their lives, blissfully unaware that Da-Young swore revenge. She begins to systematically destroy their lives as they did hers, but what happens when someone unexpected gets in the way of her best-laid plans? Will accomplishing her mission bring her happiness… or will it only get in the way of true love?

(Source: Tapas)

148393.description:
Sold to the Gwak household as a young boy, Dol-swae grows from being a shy boy to a handsome, sturdy man. He’s not the only one who grew up to be attractive, though. Lady So-hee, who he serves, and Yeo-reum, a fellow servant in the Gwak household, are now gorgeous women. The playful relationships they had together as children are now full of heated tension as they orbit each other. Something much steamier than love is in the air….

(Source: Lezhin X)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

148394.description:
Hanna, a 28-year-old college student, is getting her second undergraduate degree to become a lawyer. However, she soon realizes that she was supposed to go to a law school instead of getting a second undergraduate degree. Out of money and out of place, she joins a start-up business club to make money. Working with four other slightly weird teammates, they are starting a pet clothing business together. This feels a little funky, but everything will be fine... right?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

148396.description: About the changing relationship between childhood friends because one of them is a Mutant.

title.native: 突然変異系幼馴染ちゃん

148397.description: In a world where magical girls are outlaws... such figures routinely face hatred and persecution. One day, a well known idol's life gets turned upside-down by becoming a magical girl. And in front of her appears Shim Chung, a young magician. Will Aurora be able to finish her life as a magical girl and continue her amazing idol life?

148398.description: In a fantasy world, elf slavery is entering a new age. The two elf sisters of the noble Humbert family are captured by humans. They plan to exploit every inch of these reputed elf beauties. The elder sister, Lilia, is unfortunately the first to suffer the humans perversions.

148399.description:
Su Yuanyi comes from an immortal but anonymous clan who fight the shadow spirits formed by peoples' negative emotions, to save people's souls from being devoured. After being injured on a mission, the human boy Tang Yao was assigned to be his servant. Conflicts and misunderstandings ensued.

"Maybe Mr. Ice Cube should talk like a human being for once."

"If you've lived for 500 years then you might understand."

Can the two work together and come to an understanding, in order to heal others and heal themselves?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

synonyms: The Complete Works of Isaku Natsume

148413.description: A limited edition volume for Animate Girls' Festival (AGF), containing previously-unpublished extras for series run in Dear+ and Cheri+ magazines.

148414.description:
Whether you’ve shared many or simply yearn to feel the butterflies, experience the rush of true love’s first kiss in four charming short stories. Follow junior high pairs as their hearts reach out to one another and their lips tremble in anticipation. While some quietly harbor their feelings for a dear friend over the years, others are suddenly struck by Cupid’s arrow after one look from a stranger. Once these feelings bloom, there’s no holding back!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes two extras chapters.
synonyms: とっておきはとっておいて
うねぼれにうねぼれて
Ela quis, ele quis - O primeiro beijo

title.native: ほてりほてってファーストキス

148415.description:
After Yong-Cheol's mother suddenly faints on the day of her college entrance exam, her world is turned upside down. She starts working to pay for the hospital bills, but one day after work, a university jacket randomly lands on top of her head. Inside the jacket, she finds the ID card of a student named Chae-Yeon Lee. One thing leads to another, and she starts impersonating that student. While things seemed all right initially, the real Chae-Yeon finally shows up. How will Yong-Cheol explain her way out of this, and does this mean the end of school for her?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

148416.description:
Sonezaki Keiichi is popular... Too popular for his own good. Too popular for his own peace of mind. He hates it. He hates how most people look at him once and fall head over heels for him. The rest of them just hate him for that popularity. So he keeps to himself and only complains to his brother, Megumi. Until one day Megumi invites Takamiya Natsuki home. Just like the others, Natsuki's face shows the same expression of falling for Keiichi. But somehow, that look gives Keiichi goosebumps, rather than makes him sick. What is this? Why is that? He is baffled by it, so he sets out to find the cause...

(Source: Kaiousha, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes two extra chapters.
synonyms: I have trouble because he love me too much
I have trouble because he loves me too much

title.native: 彼が俺を好きすぎて困る
title.romaji: Kare ga Ore wo Suki Sugite Komaru
